advanced.desc: Settings intended for advanced users. It is recommended to leave these on defaults.
advanced.name: Advanced

anisotropic-filtering.desc: The degree of anisotropy to use, mainly affecting rendering of surfaces at oblique viewing angles, such as in 3D shape objects.
anisotropic-filtering.name: Anisotropic filtering

aspect-ratio.desc: The aspect ratio of the viewport.
aspect-ratio.name: Aspect ratio

author.desc: The name or organisation of the project author.
author.name: Author

auto-increment-version.desc: Check to automatically increment the fourth number of the version field after every export.
auto-increment-version.name: Auto-increment version

background-color.desc: The background color, which appears around or at the edges of the viewport.
background-color.name: Background color

bundle-addons.desc: Save installed addons with this project so it can be opened anywhere.
bundle-addons.name: Bundle addons

colors.desc: Choose colors used by the project.
colors.name: Colors

compatibility-settings.desc: Settings that exist mainly for backwards compatibility reasons. Usually these settings should not be changed.
compatibility-settings.name: Compatibility settings

description.desc: A sentence or two describing the project.
description.name: Description

display.desc: Settings affecting how the project is rendered at runtime.
display.name: Display

downscaling-quality.desc: Trade-off between display quality and memory use when drawing downscaled objects.
downscaling-quality.name: Downscaling quality

editor.desc: Settings affecting the editing and preview of the project.
editor.name: Editor

email.desc: A contact email address, such as the author or support email.
email.name: Email

enable-multitexturing.desc: Enables multitextured rendering when using WebGPU renderer. This trades off texture-swap performance for fill-rate performance.
enable-multitexturing.name: Enable multitexturing

enable-webgpu.desc: Use the WebGPU renderer if supported, which usually improves performance. Falls back to WebGL if not supported.
enable-webgpu.name: Enable WebGPU

far-distance.desc: The distance of the far plane from the camera, affecting the limits of 2D scaling and 3D rendering.
far-distance.name: Far distance

first-layout.desc: The layout that will initially load when the project is run.
first-layout.name: First layout

fixed-framerate.desc: The frames per second rate to target (subject to performance and timer precision limitations).
fixed-framerate.name: Fixed framerate

fov.desc: The angle of the visible area in front of the camera (only available when using regular Z axis scale). Note this changes the default camera Z.
fov.name: Field of view

framerate-mode.desc: How to schedule frames. Typically v-synced gives the best results.
framerate-mode.name: Framerate mode

fullscreen-mode.desc: How to resize the view to fill the available area.
fullscreen-mode.name: Fullscreen mode

fullscreen-quality.desc: Whether to scale to fullscreen before (high quality) or after (low quality) rendering.
fullscreen-quality.name: Fullscreen quality

gpu-preference.desc: On devices with multiple GPUs, the type of GPU to prefer (where supported).
gpu-preference.name: GPU preference

help-link.desc: Open the manual to learn more about project properties.
help-link.name: More information

id.desc: An identifier for this project in reverse domain format.
id.name: ID

loader-style.desc: What to show when loading, or loading the loader layout.
loader-style.name: Loader style

max-spritesheet-size.desc: The maximum spritesheet size to use. Smaller sizes save memory but larger sizes can improve performance.
max-spritesheet-size.name: Max spritesheet size

near-distance.desc: The distance of the near plane from the camera, affecting the limits of 2D scaling and 3D rendering.
near-distance.name: Near distance

orientations.desc: Where supported, the device orientations to allow.
orientations.name: Orientations

pause-on-unfocus.desc: During preview only, pause the game when the browser loses focus.
pause-on-unfocus.name: Pause on unfocus

pixel-rounding.desc: Round the position all objects are drawn at to an integer.
pixel-rounding.name: Pixel rounding

preload-sounds.desc: Download and decode all sounds (but not music) while loading.
preload-sounds.name: Preload sounds

preview-effects.desc: Preview blend modes and effects in the editor.
preview-effects.name: Preview effects

rendering-mode.desc: Whether to render this project in 2D mode, 3D mode, or automatically decide.
rendering-mode.name: Rendering mode

splash-color.desc: The background color of the splash screen, which appears when run as a web app.
splash-color.name: Splash color

startup.desc: Settings affecting how the project loads and starts.
startup.name: Startup

theme-color.desc: On some platforms the theme color replaces the default UI color.
theme-color.name: Theme color

uid-numbering.desc: The numbering scheme to use for assigning a UID to new objects.
uid-numbering.name: UID numbering

use-loader-layout.desc: Display the first layout while the rest of the project is still loading.
use-loader-layout.name: Use loader layout

use-theme-color.desc: Whether to enable the theme color, which replaces the default UI color on some platforms.
use-theme-color.name: Use theme color

use-worker.desc: Host the runtime in a Web Worker, off the main thread.
use-worker.name: Use worker

version.desc: Up to four numbers to identify the version of the project.
version.name: Version

viewport-fit.desc: How to handle non-rectangular displays like on the iPhone X.
viewport-fit.name: Viewport fit

viewport-size.desc: The size of the viewport area in pixels.

height.desc: The height of the viewport area in pixels.
height.name: Height

viewport-size.name: Viewport size

width.desc: The width of the viewport area in pixels.
width.name: Width

website.desc: The website associated with this project.
website.name: Website

convert.confirmation-message: Converting the project to Z axis scale 'Regular' will affect the Z co-ordinate and depth of all 3D content in all layouts and layers in the project. This cannot be undone. Note this does not affect your event sheets or code which may still need to be manually updated. Do you want to continue?
convert.desc: Click to convert the project to Z axis scale 'Regular'.
convert.name: Convert Z axis scale

z-axis-scale.desc: The scale of units to use on the Z axis for 3D features. 'Regular' uses same units as X/Y axes. 'Normalized' works 0-100 and is deprecated - use 'Regular' mode instead.
z-axis-scale.name: Z axis scale
z-axis-scale.normalized-confirmation: Z axis scale 'Normalized' is deprecated. In future this mode will be removed in favor of 'Regular' mode. Are you sure you want to change the Z axis scale to 'Normalized'?
